solutionCode:
import sys
import json
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def findOrder(numTasks: int, prerequisites: list) -> list:
    adj = defaultdict(list)
    indegree = [0] * numTasks
    for dest, src in prerequisites:
        adj[src].append(dest)
        indegree[dest] += 1
    
    queue = deque([i for i in range(numTasks) if indegree[i] == 0])
    order = []
    
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        order.append(node)
        for neighbor in adj[node]:
            indegree[neighbor] -= 1
            if indegree[neighbor] == 0:
                queue.append(neighbor)
                
    return order if len(order) == numTasks else []

if __name__ == '__main__':
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if input_data:
        numTasks, prerequisites = json.loads(input_data)
        res = findOrder(numTasks, prerequisites)
        print(json.dumps(res))

title: Performance Crisis: Max Subarray Sum
description: Performance Crisis! The maximum contiguous subarray algorithm runs in O(N^2) nested loops. Optimize the logic to execute in O(N) linear time using Kadane's algorithm.
solutionCode:
import sys
import json

def maxSubArray(nums: list) -> int:
    max_so_far = nums[0]
    curr_max = nums[0]
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        curr_max = max(nums[i], curr_max + nums[i])
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, curr_max)
    return max_so_far

if __name__ == '__main__':
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if input_data:
        nums = json.loads(input_data)
        print(maxSubArray(nums))
